NONE: › a very small, simple organism consisting of only one cell
變形蟲，阿米巴原蟲
› an illness of the bowels caused by an amoeba
阿米巴痢疾
› to be out of control and act in a wild or dangerous manner
狂亂，狂暴，發狂

example: The soldiers ran amok after one of their senior officers was killed.
一名高級軍官被殺後，這支軍隊開始胡作非為。
The two dogs ran amok in a school playground.
那兩隻狗在學校操場上廝咬起來。

NONE: B1 in the middle of or surrounded by other things
在…中；為…所環繞
A2 happening or being included as part of a group of people or things
在…（群體）中；…之一
C1 to each one in a group of three or more people or things
在三者或以上數量的人或物之間

example: I saw a few familiar faces among the crowd.
我在人群中看見了幾張熟悉的面孔。
Rescue teams searched among the wreckage for survivors.
救援隊在殘骸中搜尋倖存者。
a decision that has caused a lot of anger among women
在婦女中引起極大憤怒的決議
Relax, you're amongst friends.
你別緊張，大家都是朋友。
Talk about it among yourselves (= talk to each other about it without me) for a while.
你們先討論一會兒。
She has worked as an estate agent among other things (= as well as other things).
她做過很多工作，其中之一就是做房地產經紀人。
He divided the country among his sons.
他把王國分給了幾個兒子。
The cost should be shared equally among the three of you.
你們三人應該均攤成本支出。

NONE: › a brown sherry (= a type of strong wine) that is not sweet
雪利酒的一種（性烈，無甜味）
› without moral principles
毫無道德觀念的；沒有道德的

example: Humans, he argues, are amoral and what guides them is not any sense of morality but an instinct for survival.
他認為，人類無德，其行為不是出於道德感，而是出於生存的本能。
Compare
immoral

NONE: › of or expressing sexual desire
表示性愛的；色情的

example: The opera centres around the amorous adventures/exploits of its handsome hero.
這部歌劇以英俊的男主角的艷遇為主線。
Amanda had rejected his amorous advances.
阿曼達拒絕了他的求愛。

NONE: › having no fixed form or shape
無固定形狀的；不定形的

example: an amorphous mass of jelly
一團稀軟的果凍

NONE: › to reduce a debt by paying small regular amounts
分期償還（債務）

example: The value of the machinery is amortized over its estimated useful life.
機器的貨款在其預計使用年限期間分期支付。

NONE: B1 a collection or mass, especially of something that cannot be counted
（尤指不可數事物的）數量；數額；量；總數

example: They didn't deliver the right amount of sand.
他們運來的沙子數量不對。
Small amounts of land were used for keeping animals.
少量的土地用於飼養動物。
He paid regular amounts of money to a charity.
他定期向一家慈善機構捐錢。
I didn't expect the bill to come to this amount (= of money).
我沒有料到帳單上的金額會這麼大。
The new tax caused a huge amount of public anger.
新稅收引起了強烈公憤。
I had a certain amount of (= some) difficulty finding the house.
我找到這房子費了不少勁。
You wouldn't believe the amount of trouble (= what a lot of trouble) I've had with this car.
你決不會相信這輛汽車給我帶來了多少麻煩。

NONE: › to become a particular amount
達到；總計
› to be the same as something, or to have the same effect as something
等於；意味著

example: His behaviour amounted to serious professional misconduct.
他的行為相當於嚴重失職。
He gave what amounted to an apology on behalf of his company.
他的話等於是替公司道了歉。

NONE: › a belief and confidence in your own ability and value
自尊心；自信心
